a11y_responsive.evidence: Audit: blockers=[], contrast_fail_count 0, focus_invisible_count 0 of 25, tap_targets_under_44 0, img_missing_alt 0, landmarks main/nav/footer true, horizontal_overflow false. Skip is off-canvas and returns on focus at 44px. Mosaic empty alts under role=img. Team alts describe the group not names. mobile_full is a one-column reflow; tablet_full is two-column. Remaining: JS-only mobile nav, unnamed spec tables, 12.5px footer type, form novalidate.
strengths: Clean audit: 0 contrast fails, 0 invisible focus, 0 sub-44 targets, skip + one h1 + landmarks.
Labeled quote form with aria-invalid and real tel/WhatsApp/PDF anchors.
375px and tablet reflow; mosaic decorative imgs empty-alt; team photo unnamed as demanded.

issues.problem: Nav list is display:none until JS toggles .nav.open.
issues.fix: Add a noscript or :target rule so #navlist displays as a column below 1024px without main.js.

issues.problem: Data tables use th scope=row but have no caption or aria-label.
issues.fix: Add a visually-hidden caption on the spec, plant, and company-details tables.

issues.problem: footer font-size .78125rem (12.5px) is below a 14px low-vision floor.
issues.fix: Set footer to font-size 1rem; if CIN must stay quieter, use .875rem on that line only.

issues.problem: novalidate turns off native required when JS is off, and the form has no action URL.
issues.fix: Remove novalidate; keep the JS preventDefault path; add a mailto or server action.
